chunks: Al-Fadl, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Thalaba, from Shu'ayb al-Haddad, from Salih, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say: 'There is no gap between the rising of the Qaim and the killing of the Pure Soul except fifteen nights.'

key_terms.النَّفْسُ الزَّكِيَّةُ: The Pure Soul (a specific figure martyred before the reappearance)

ai.seo_question: What is the time gap between the rise of the Qaim and the killing of the Pure Soul?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) specifies a brief fifteen-night interval between the Qaim’s emergence and the martyrdom of the Pure Soul (Nafs al-Zakiyyah), a key figure in Shia eschatology. This concise timeframe underscores the rapid acceleration of divine justice and the immediate consolidation of authority following the initial signs of reappearance.
